After 4.5 hours of driving you normally need an unbroken 45-minute break.
On an occasional passenger service you may instead take two breaks of at least 15 minutes each, spread over the 4.5-hour driving period so that the 4.5-hour limit is still respected.
Any driver may also split the break into at least 15 minutes followed by at least 30 minutes.
Separately, the working time rules say you must never work more than 6 hours in a row without a break.
If you work 6 to 9 hours in total, your breaks must add up to at least 30 minutes, and at least 45 minutes if you work more than 9 hours.
Under these working time rules, breaks can be split into parts of at least 15 minutes.
